audio.text: Can you close the door, please?

why.en: Request → agreement. B is a sound-alike trap ("close the door" / "close to here"); D repeats "close" about something else.
why.tr: Rica → kabul. B ses benzerliği tuzağı ("close the door" / "close to here"); D "close" kelimesini başka bir şey için tekrar ediyor.
why.es: Petición → aceptación. B es una trampa de sonido parecido ("close the door" / "close to here"); D repite "close" sobre otra cosa.
